vt1025013.title: Sigma 150-600mm f/5-6.3 DG OS HSM Contemporary Zoom Lens for Nikon F Mount
vt1025013.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1025013.details: Sigma 150-600mm f/5-6.3 DG OS HSM Contemporary telephoto zoom lens in the Nikon F mount, with optical stabilization and a hypersonic motor. Condition: very clean, with light scuffs from use. The tripod collar has scuffs and the mount has very slight scuffs, and the markings are sharp and clear (please see the photos). Optics: clear, with no fungus or haze, no scratches on the front or rear element and clean coatings; a very small amount of internal dust may be present but does not affect shooting. Operation was checked at a camera specialty shop with no problems, and the zoom and focus rings turn smoothly. Included, as shown in the photos: the lens with its tripod collar, the lens hood, the front and rear caps and the printed leaflet. No box or case is included.
vt1025013.why: A used Sigma 150-600mm f/5-6.3 DG OS HSM Contemporary lens for Nikon F.
vt1025013.perfect: Wildlife, bird, aircraft and sports photographers who want a long telephoto zoom for Nikon DSLRs.
vt1025013.exp: A pre-owned Sigma 150-600mm f/5-6.3 DG OS HSM Contemporary lens for Nikon F in the condition described above.
vt1025013.cd: Pre-owned in very clean condition with light scuffs from use. The tripod collar has scuffs and the mount has very slight scuffs; the markings are sharp and clear. The optics are clear with no fungus or haze, no scratches on the front or rear element and clean coatings; a very small amount of internal dust may be present but does not affect shooting. Operation was checked at a camera specialty shop and the rings turn smoothly. Included: the lens, hood, caps and leaflet as shown.
